name: rd-ralph-loop
description: Evidence-gated single- or multi-repository Ralph loops with auditable controls.

interface.longDescription: Run interactive Planner, Implementer, and Reviewer loops across a CONTROL workspace and optional participant Git repositories, with typed findings, bounded implementation growth, auditable checkpoints, evidence-gated archival, and a user-controlled manual-merge handoff.
defaultPrompt: Run this R&D task in an isolated worktree through checkpointed implementation and independent acceptance, then prepare a manual-merge handoff.
Create the four-document task pack, dedicated branch, and first checkpointed implementation loop.
Resume this Ralph loop from its current branch, plan, candidate commit, and verification evidence.
